validation.meaning: Assertions document currently observed defects and positive controls; not repaired contracts

findings.title: Generic strategies shadow PATH_UPDATE and RX_LOG_DATA route processing
findings.expected: Synchronize path and preserve identified passive RF route observations
findings.observed: Path synchronization calls=0; normal RX_LOG route=None; direct helper control route.count=2
findings.cause: Handlers return from dispatch before specialized branches
findings.proposed_fix: Assign route processing to event strategies or before generic dispatch; preserve serial transaction ownership

findings.title: RX concurrency semaphore does not bound pending tasks
findings.expected: Explicit bounded admission/backpressure and event preservation policy
findings.observed: 1000 retained own tasks, 20 active handlers, all drain when gate releases
findings.proposed_fix: Bounded worker queue and valid coalescing; agree capacity and overflow policy with user
findings.limitations: Synthetic burst; does not establish persistent leak or SBC performance

findings.title: Expired ACK correlation survives and recent table lacks hard cap
findings.expected: Respect correlation validity and explicitly bounded pending state
findings.observed: ACK at age7200s emits old request id; 1000 recent entries remain; entry not consumed
findings.cause: Lookup has no TTL; cleanup only on new registration above threshold200
findings.proposed_fix: Consistent expiry, capacity and duplicate resolution semantics with agreed TTL/limits

findings.title: Presentation defaults contaminate persisted domain state and analytics
findings.expected: Unknown observed/configuration fields remain null across reload
findings.cause: Persistence reuses public presentation DTO containing inferred defaults
findings.proposed_fix: Separate raw storage schema, observed public DTO and suggested defaults; migrate historical ambiguity

findings.title: Raw setter accepts unrelated Companion response as confirmation
findings.expected: SET_NAME waits for its allowed OK or ERROR response
findings.observed: SET_NAME opcode8 returnsTrue from unrelated BATTERY0x0C without setter ACK
findings.cause: Any response opcode<0x80 resolves raw future except contact stream special case
findings.proposed_fix: Allowed response map by command, stream semantics and conservative recovery after timeout

findings.title: Unsolicited SELF_INFO reintroduces unsigned TX representation
findings.expected: Signed firmware TX=-9 remains normalized in live cache
findings.observed: SDK byte247 overwrites normalized local_config -9 with247 and logs247dBm
findings.cause: Event path does not share explicit configuration read normalizer
findings.proposed_fix: Common normalization boundary for SELF_INFO and explicit query

findings.title: Backward wall clock reorders equal-priority messages
findings.observed: counter2 atwall90 dequeues before counter1 atwall100
findings.cause: Ordered dataclass compares wall timestamp before sequence counter
findings.proposed_fix: Compare priority and sequence; keep wall timestamp as nonordering metadata

findings.title: Maintained name index does not serve name lookups
findings.expected: State is either used for correct multivalued lookup or not maintained
findings.observed: Clearing index leaves name and alias lookups working; only mutation/cleanup consumers found in checkout
findings.proposed_fix: Remove internal index or implement multivalued ambiguity-safe index
findings.limitations: Private attribute consumers outside checkout cannot be ruled out

unconfirmed_risks: Cancellation does not stop I/O worker thread
Airtime payload estimate differs from complete radio measurement
Public load_history reentry appends but production currently calls once
positive_controls: Disconnect completes raw pending future False and clears SDK reference
RX backlog drains fully after slow consumer gate releases

inventory.method: All22 files ast.parse plus manually traced flows listed in runtime.md; not universal dynamic method coverage
